scriptureWordingAssessment: The surviving P.Oxy. XVII 2069 wording in 1 Enoch 85:10 is fragmentary but agrees with the existing sequence and multiplicity expressed by ‘one following another’; it provides no demonstrable basis for changing the current Scripture wording.
sourceAttestationChanges: Removed the false claim that no surviving Greek manuscript preserves wording from Chapter 85.
Recorded P.Oxy. XVII 2069, fragments 1r–2r, as a fragmentary Greek witness spanning 1 Enoch 85:10–86:2, with Chapter 85 overlap limited to verse 10.
Corrected the Dillmann page scope for Chapter 85 from printed pages 61–63 to printed pages 61–62.
Clarified that the complete Geʽez witness supplies Chapter 85 wording not preserved in the fragmentary Greek witness.
